title: Comparison of Different Energy Sources During TUR-P
brief_summary: With this study, it is aimed to compare the operative results and complication rates in transurethral resection of the prostate (TUR-P) performed by resectoscopes with two different bipolar and a monopolar energy sources.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Having an indication due to BPH
* Aged between 40 and 80 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Kidney failure due to BPH
* Any kind of coagulopathy or use of anticoagulants in the preoperative period
* History of any previous open or endoscopic prostate surgery
